title: BUGFIX — Fix hardcoded /Users/tarekmnif paths in kognai.ecosystem.config.js and shell scripts
rationale: Sprint 1419 fixed ecosystem.config.js but missed kognai.ecosystem.config.js (the Kognai-native PM2 config with router/dashboard/drain/heartbeat processes) and 3 shell scripts. kognai.ecosystem.config.js had /Users/tarekmnif hardcoded in cwd, out_file, error_file, PYTHONPATH, and TS_NODE_PROJECT fields. scripts/start-router.sh, generate-daily-brief.sh, and install-clawhub-skills.sh all had hardcoded project root paths. Fixed: kognai.ecosystem.config.js uses __dirname, shell scripts use $(cd $(dirname $0)/.. && pwd) to resolve root dynamically.

tasks.description: Replace all /Users/tarekmnif/kognai in kognai.ecosystem.config.js with __dirname. Add path require. Validated: node -e require() -> VALID — 4 apps.

Replace hardcoded /Users/tarekmnif/kognai in scripts/start-router.sh, scripts/generate-daily-brief.sh, scripts/install-clawhub-skills.sh with KOGNAI_ROOT=$(cd $(dirname $0)/.. && pwd). All 3 scripts now self-locate the project root at runtime.
